The '''Vanaria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Vanarian Tree Eater]]s.<ref name="SWGH" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vanaria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
